options.content:
| Date | Activity |
|---|---|
| **August 13, 2026** | Thermal paste replaced with **Arctic MX-6** |
| **August 13, 2026** | Dust cleaned out (fans & heatsink) |
| **April 2026** | Serviced at an ASUS Service Center |

Relevant context for interpreting the CPU/GPU temperature trends in the panels below — the baseline shifted after this maintenance, so data before & after these dates isn't apples-to-apples.

panels.description: Package id 0 temperature right now (real-time, not historical).
panels.title: CPU Package Temp - Current

panels.description: Average temperature of the 'Package id 0' sensor (not an average across cores) over the dashboard's time range. This is the value the BIOS/OS uses for thermal throttling decisions.
panels.title: CPU Package Temp - Avg

panels.description: Lowest Package temperature recorded over the dashboard's time range.
panels.title: CPU Package Temp - Min

panels.description: Highest Package temperature recorded over the dashboard's time range.
panels.title: CPU Package Temp - Max

panels.description: The 'Package id 0' sensor only — a separate physical sensor from the 6 cores, and the one used by the BIOS/OS for thermal throttling.
panels.title: CPU Package Temp (°C)

panels.description: 6 individual core sensors (Core 0-5) — separate from Package. Useful for seeing which specific core is running hottest.
panels.title: CPU Per-Core Temp (°C)

panels.description: Number of processes queued waiting for resources (CPU/disk/network), NOT a CPU percentage. This machine has 12 logical threads — the dashed red line at 12 marks the point where it's 'full' and processes start queuing.
panels.title: Load Average

panels.description: CPU fan RPM (sensor 'fan1' on the ASUS embedded controller). Thresholds recalibrated from 15 days of real data (min 3000, avg 5420, max 5600 RPM) after the originally-supplied 5300 RPM 'spec max' turned out to be exceeded ~100% of the time — no publicly documented official max RPM exists for this fan; the closest reference found was ~5000 RPM on aftermarket replacement part listings, also below observed reality.
panels.title: CPU Fan RPM

panels.description: GPU temperature right now (real-time, not historical).
panels.title: GPU Temp - Current

panels.description: Average GPU temperature over the dashboard's time range (not an instant snapshot).
panels.title: GPU Temp - Avg

panels.description: Lowest GPU temperature recorded over the dashboard's time range.
panels.title: GPU Temp - Min

panels.description: Highest GPU temperature recorded over the dashboard's time range.
panels.title: GPU Temp - Max

panels.description: GPU fan RPM (sensor 'fan2' on the ASUS embedded controller). Thresholds recalibrated from 15 days of real data (min 2500, avg 4930, max 5100 RPM) for the same reason as CPU Fan RPM — see its description.
panels.title: GPU Fan RPM

panels.description: Left axis: RAM used as a percentage. Right axis: absolute RAM used vs. total, in GB.
panels.title: RAM Usage

panels.description: Left axis: disk used as a percentage. Right axis: absolute disk used vs. free space, in GB, on the root (/) partition.
panels.title: Disk Usage - /

panels.description: Top 10 containers by CPU. The top-10 set is resolved once, pinned to the end of the dashboard's time range via the @ end() modifier — a plain topk() is re-ranked at every step of a range query, so containers drift in and out and the graph fills with broken part-series (measured: 25 series, 12 fragmented, for a topk(10) over 6h).

targets.expr:
sum by (name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name!=""}[5m])) * 100
  and
topk(10, avg_over_time(sum by (name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name!=""}[5m]))[$__range:5m] @ end()))

panels.title: Per-Container CPU Usage

panels.description: RAM summed per docker-compose project (the container_label_com_docker_compose_project label cAdvisor already exposes), not per individual container. Containers without a compose project label are grouped under '(no compose project)'.
panels.title: RAM by Project/Stack
